name: Yu Entai
bio: Yu Entai is a highly educated Chinese actor and TV host. He is most well known for his classic role as The Scholar Lü Qinghou in the beloved sitcom My Own Swordsman. he prioritized academic pursuits at the height of his popularity, delaying his doctoral studies to film the show and later completing his PhD.
